# Spout SDK source subset

Unmodified DirectX 11 dependency closure from leadedge/Spout2 tag `2.007.017`.
Source: https://github.com/leadedge/Spout2/tree/2.007.017
License: BSD-2-Clause, reproduced in `licenses/Spout2-BSD-2-Clause.txt`.

The selected files are copied verbatim. Headers are colocated; upstream's
`__has_include("SpoutCommon.h")` path supports this layout. Samples, OpenGL
renderers, prebuilt binaries and unrelated SDK components are not included.
